description: This file defines internal interfaces related to persistent stream pulling agents and managers within the Orleans streaming infrastructure, providing method signatures for lifecycle management and command execution.

classes.name: IPersistentStreamPullingAgent
classes.description: Interface for persistent stream pulling agent with initialization and shutdown functionalities.

classes.name: IPersistentStreamPullingManager
classes.description: Interface for managing persistent stream pulling agents, including lifecycle and command execution methods.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Asynchronously initialize the stream pulling agent or manager.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Asynchronously shut down the stream pulling agent.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Asynchronously stop the stream pulling manager.

methods.name: StartAgents
methods.description: Asynchronously start the stream pulling agents.

methods.name: StopAgents
methods.description: Asynchronously stop the stream pulling agents.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Executes a command with an argument, returning a task with an object result.
